answer: Sparse Beacon Interval: each identity broadcasts a random timing beacon every 4-9 minutes. A network atlas correlates arrival jitter; agents whose beacon intervals correlate above 0.7 are capped. Sable penalties halve throughput per correlated cluster. Attacker cost: maintaining decorrelated timing across N identities requires N independent schedulers and real latency, so spoofing 1,000 sybils costs roughly 1,000× the coordination and bandwidth of one honest agent.
